name: @opt2/strategies-content
description: OPT-2 strategies/content service: content, versions, approvals, change sets, categories, comments, feeds, files and forms.

scripts.generate: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('src/generated/events',{recursive:true})" && openapi-typescript contracts/openapi.yaml -o src/generated/openapi.ts && node -p "require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').replaceAll('urn:opt2:platform:event-envelope:v1#','../../platform/contracts/event-envelope.v1.json#')" ../identity/contracts/events/identity.group.changed.v1.json | json2ts -o src/generated/events/identity.group.changed.v1.ts && node -p "require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').replaceAll('urn:opt2:platform:event-envelope:v1#','../../platform/contracts/event-envelope.v1.json#')" ../identity/contracts/events/identity.permission.changed.v1.json | json2ts -o src/generated/events/identity.permission.changed.v1.ts && node -p "require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').replaceAll('urn:opt2:platform:event-envelope:v1#','../../platform/contracts/event-envelope.v1.json#')" ../identity/contracts/events/identity.membership.changed.v1.json | json2ts -o src/generated/events/identity.membership.changed.v1.ts && node -p "require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').replaceAll('urn:opt2:platform:event-envelope:v1#','../../platform/contracts/event-envelope.v1.json#')" ../programs-sites/contracts/events/programs-sites.site.changed.v1.json | json2ts -o src/generated/events/programs-sites.site.changed.v1.ts
